events.name: Bash
events.head: Check related task state and live nurture status

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how to run the nurture probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; head -30 app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs | grep -iE "usage|run|BASE|SIM|localhost" | head; grep -n "from\|sender" workshop-plan/sequences/campaign-setup.md | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find local centre start helper
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "18890" app/scripts cloud/scripts cloud/package.json 2>/dev/null | head; sed -n 1,25p app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs | grep -n "ADMIN_KEY\|wrangler\|start"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe header and wrangler config
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,22p app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs; ls cloud/.dev.vars* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "vendor-sim\|TANTRA_API\|\[vars\]" cloud/wrangler.toml | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect local dev config names
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; ls wrangler* ; cut -d= -f1 .dev.vars; grep -n "TANTRA_BASE\|TANTRA_API_URL\|tantraUrl" src/connectors/stack.ts | head -5; head -15 scripts/vendor-sim.py | grep -i "port\|usage"

events.text: Running the nurture probe locally against the vendor simulator before updating the task.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how centre targets the simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; grep -n "const TN\|function TN\|isSim\s*=\|function isSim\|sim_url\|SIM_URL" src/connectors/stack.ts | head -6; grep -n "SIM\|sim" ../app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs | sed -n 1,12p

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start simulator and local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; lsof -ti:18890,18892 | head; SIM_PORT=18892 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t052-sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py >/tmp/t052-sim.log 2>&1 & echo SIM $!; nohup npx wrangler dev --port 18890 --local --persist-to /tmp/t052-wr --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:18892 >/tmp/t052-wr.log 2>&1 & echo WR $!

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply local migrations and check centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; grep -n '"database_name"\|"binding"' wrangler.jsonc | head -3; DB=$(grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); yes | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply $DB --local --persist-to /tmp/t052-wr 2>&1 | tail -3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:18890/ ; tail -3 /tmp/t052-wr.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run nurture probe against simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; ADMIN_KEY=$(grep '^ADMIN_KEY=' ../cloud/.dev.vars | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"') CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:18890 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:18892 node scripts/probe-nurture.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8

events.text:

This run has no approval code either, so I could not create the campaigns or switch them on.

- **New block:** needs_from_owner now asks Adi to connect team@growthclub.org at https://app.usetantra.com under Email Accounts, Connect account (same ask as T-123).
- **Code check:** I ran `probe-nurture.mjs` on a fresh local copy of the centre against the vendor simulator, and every check passed:

  - **At Day 3 end:** the same attendee is added to Post-workshop and gets message 1.
  - **Repeat runs:** a second run adds nobody twice.
  - **Banned tools:** no n8n, Instantly, SendGrid or Twilio call anywhere in the path.
- **Note R-d73d14ce:** acknowledged.
- **Not committed:** I did not commit the task-file changes. `tasks.json` already had other people's uncommitted edits, so the runner will commit it.
